podcast.title: Early Band with Tony Visconti Deal
podcast.body: Omaha Sheriff was Chris Berkett's band that signed a record deal with Tony Visconti for a couple of albums. "my band was called Omaha Sheriff and that was Tony became my mentor while I was in the studio."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Tracking at Tapestry Studios
podcast.body: The band recorded some of their first Omaha Sheriff tracking at Tapestry Studios, which was owned by John Kongos in London. "we recorded our first Omaha show. Some of the tracking was done at Tapestry Studios, which is John's studio."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Designing and Building Tapestry Studios
xref.body: After leaving Omaha Sheriff and working as a milkman, Chris Berkett was asked by John Kongos to design and build his new studio in London, Tapestry Studios, leveraging his electronics degree. "Would you like to come and design and build my new studio?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Early Career Mentorship with Tony Visconti
xref.body: Chris Berkett signed a deal for a couple of albums with Tony Visconti and his band Omaha Sheriff. While in the studio, Berkett constantly asked Visconti questions due to his electronics degree, learning how to make records by observing him. "I learned how to make records by watching Tony."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
